Be Seen.name: Be Seen
Be Seen.description:
📣 You want to be noticed: your name known, your work recognized, your face remembered. Never ignored again.

🧭 This motivation shapes the chances the story offers: the Sports Festival, interviews, debuts and viral clips.
⚠️ Attention brings scrutiny too: critics, online mobs, reporters who twist a story and fans who want something.
💭 Attention is not the same as being seen, and recognition comes only from what you do.
Be Seen.traitNarrativeEffects: The character wants recognition: to be acknowledged for who they are and what they do. The narrator surfaces stages and audiences: the U.A. Sports Festival, which the whole country watches in place of the old Olympics, interviews, hero debuts, viral clips, a mentor who notices quiet effort, a teacher's praise. It also brings scrutiny: critics, online mobs, reporters who twist a story, fans who want something, and villains who crave an audience of their own. Pressures: attention is not the same as being seen, and fame can bury the person it was meant to show. Recognition comes from what the character does in the story, never by default, and the narrator never decides what they do for attention.
